title: complete-json-call.v1
description: One structured-output completion: the request contract, and optionally its result. Unlike usage-record.v1 this envelope MAY carry content (the prompt and the parsed value); producers that must stay content-free store request/result separately and keep only the refs. The cache key is derived from request fields (key_scheme names how), so a recording made by one producer replays only under the same scheme. Aligned with awork-resume's complete_json(ref, system, prompt, out, prompt_version).

family.description: Model family, used by a consumer's maker/checker independence rule; opaque to moeka.

alias.description: moeka ModelSpec alias, when the producer is moeka.

prompt.description: The user message. A multi-message conversation is not part of this contract; use the kernel Request directly.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 compatible) of the expected object, e.g. pydantic model_json_schema().

prompt_version.description: Caller's version label of system+prompt template; part of the cache key.

temperature.description: Cache-keyed calls are temperature 0 by contract.

max_rounds.description: Request rounds allowed (awork-resume: 2 = one re-prompt; moeka: 1 + retries).

cache_mode.description: replay: a miss is an error, never a provider call.

request_key.description: Derived cache/replay key; opaque outside key_scheme.

key_scheme.description: How request_key is computed. awr.sha256.v1: sha256 of canonical JSON {provider, model, system, prompt, schema, prompt_version, max_tokens, t:0}. moeka.request_key.v1: kernel.llm.request_key over messages, alias, model, provider, sampling, schema, retries (and prompt_version when set).

parsed.description: The validated object; absent unless outcome is ok.

store.description: Where the raw reply text lives (llm_cache, recording, session).

raw_ref.description: Reference to the raw reply text; the text itself is not inlined.

attempts.description: Physical rounds that reached a provider; 0 for a cache hit.

usage_record_ids.description: usage-record.v1 record_id of every attempt (one cache_hit record for a hit). Empty only when no provider was reached and none was recorded (replay miss, pre-admission refusal).

final_record_id.description: record_id of the attempt that produced parsed.

budget_event_id.description: call_id of the budget-event.v1 when outcome is budget_refused.
